en: Il Gabbiano's dining room and kitchen are open.
zh: Il Gabbiano 的餐廳和廚房開放了。

en: Characters now talk and blink when they speak.
zh: 角色說話時會動嘴巴、會眨眼了。

en: Nico's house is open: walk into the Bellacosta home.
zh: Nico 的家開放了：走進 Bellacosta 家。

en: Port Paloma opens faster, and shows you how far along it is.
zh: Port Paloma 開得更快，還會顯示載入進度。

en: Every mission now has a medal to earn and a bonus goal.
zh: 每個任務都有獎牌可拿，還有一個額外挑戰。

en: Phones: scenes that need a key now show it, and tapping Use works as well as holding.
zh: 手機：需要按鍵的場景會顯示提示，點按「使用」和按住一樣有效。

en: New: this What's new card. See what changed, every day.
zh: 新增：「最新更新」卡片，每天的改動都在這裡。

en: Lost on a drive? The marker now pulses and a hint shows the way.
zh: 開車找不到路？標記會閃動，還有提示幫你指路。

en: Phones: Punch is always at hand, and every button has an icon.
zh: 手機：「揮拳」隨時可按，每個按鈕都有圖示。

en: Phones no longer crash when you walk into a building.
zh: 手機走進建築物不會再當掉。

en: Hold your phone upright and the game turns sideways for you.
zh: 手機直拿也能玩：畫面會自動轉成橫向。

en: Port Paloma opens on the web: free, in your browser.
zh: Port Paloma 上線：免費、用瀏覽器就能玩。
